DeepCool AG400 PLUS 120mm CPU Cooler – High-Performance Cooling for Intel & AMD

The DeepCool AG400 PLUS 120mm CPU Cooler is designed to deliver powerful and efficient cooling, perfect for gamers, PC enthusiasts, and builders. Featuring a single tower design and four direct-touch heat pipes, this cooler offers up to 220W of thermal dissipation, making it an excellent choice for mid-range CPUs.

Key Features:

  • Cooling Performance: Efficiently dissipates up to 220W TDP with 4 direct-touch heat pipes.
  • Fan Specs: A 120mm fan with speeds of 500–2000 RPM, 75.89 CFM airflow, and low noise levels (≤31.6 dB).
  • Enhanced Heat Pipe Technology: Balanced bidirectional heat pipe structure for consistent performance, regardless of case orientation.
  • Hydro Bearing Fan: Ensures quiet operation and extended lifespan.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with Intel LGA1700, 1200, 1151, 1150, 1155 and AMD AM5, AM4 sockets.
  • ARGB Lighting: Customizable addressable RGB lighting (in compatible models) adds a touch of style to your build.

Why Choose the DeepCool AG400 PLUS?

Reliable and cost-effective cooling solution.

Ideal for mid-range CPUs in gaming and everyday desktop builds.

Easy installation with the fan lock mounting system.

Compatibility:

  • Intel: LGA1700, 1200, 1151, 1150, 1155
  • AMD: AM5, AM4
